texts:
Saturday's final injury reports are in for Week 6, and Philadelphia loses its quarterback for a month. Here is what moved, team by team.

Jalen Hurts goes on IR.

A.J. Brown is off IR.

Mike Evans is questionable.
#FlyEaglesFly #NEPats #FTTB

Jalen Hurts goes on IR with the blood clot, out at least four weeks. Earliest return is Nov 22. QB9 rest of season for me; hold him in an IR spot.

Dameon Pierce has the backfield vs CAR with Saquon Barkley out. RB20 for me, an RB2.
#FlyEaglesFly #KeepPounding

Dallas Goedert catches passes from Tanner McKee vs CAR. TE10 for me.

Bryce Young is QB10 for me @PHI.
#FlyEaglesFly #KeepPounding

A.J. Brown is off IR after three limited practices with the high ankle sprain, and he is questionable vs NYJ in his first game since Week 1. WR24 rest of season for me. Monitor; Sunday's inactives, 90 minutes before kickoff.
#NEPats #JetUp

Rhamondre Stevenson played 71 percent of the snaps vs LV, and TreVeyon Henderson is questionable. RB12 for me, borderline RB1/RB2 this week.

Braelon Allen has the Jets backfield with Breece Hall out. RB18 for me @NE, an RB2.
#NEPats #JetUp

Mike Evans is questionable vs WAS after missing Thursday and Friday and working on the side Saturday with the ribs and Achilles. WR18 for me, a WR2. Monitor; Monday's inactives at 6:45 PM ET.
#FTTB #RaiseHail

Deebo Samuel is out again, and George Kittle is TE2 for me Monday night.

Christian McCaffrey is RB5 for me vs WAS.
#FTTB #RaiseHail

Jacory Croskey-Merritt is ruled out with the groin. Rachaad White played 60 percent of the snaps to Croskey-Merritt's 35 in Week 5.

Pivot to White, RB25 for me @SF, a high-end RB3.
#RaiseHail #FTTB

Terry McLaurin has no injury designation after a limited Saturday with the hamstring. WR21 for me @SF, a WR2.

Stefon Diggs is questionable with his hamstring. Monitor; Monday's inactives at 6:45 PM ET.
#RaiseHail #FTTB

Caleb Williams is expected to start @ATL after three full practices with the hamstring, his first game since Week 2. QB8 for me.

Luther Burden III is WR20 for me, a WR2.

Colston Loveland is TE15 for me, a streamer.
#DaBears #DirtyBirds

Josh Jacobs comes off the Commissioner's Exempt List Monday and is eligible for Week 7. RB37 rest of season for me; hold him.

MarShawn Lloyd is RB22 for me vs DAL, an RB2, and RB41 rest of season. Trade him away after Sunday night.
#GoPackGo #DallasCowboys

DJ Moore is questionable @LV after a limited Friday with the shoulder. WR23 rest of season for me. Monitor; Sunday's inactives at 2:55 PM ET.

Keon Coleman is WR39 for me, a low-end flex play to a dart throw.
#BillsMafia #RaiderNation

Ashton Jeanty practiced in full all week with the foot and has no designation. RB13 for me, borderline RB1/RB2 this week.

Brock Bowers has no designation either. TE1 for me vs BUF.
#RaiderNation #BillsMafia

Germie Bernard keeps the No. 2 role @TB with Roman Wilson out. WR34 for me, a low-end WR3.

Pat Freiermuth is TE13 for me, a borderline start this week.
#HereWeGo #GoBucs

Every Week 6 call is on the Pass, updated through Monday night. Follow @FF_ChefHazy for the rest of the week's calls, and repost this for your league.

https://fantasykitchenff.com/pass.html
